title: Fundamental Rights
description: Quiz on fundamental rights guaranteed by Nepal's Constitution

questions.question: Which article of Nepal's Constitution deals with the Right to Equality?
questions.explanation: Article 18 of Nepal's Constitution guarantees the Right to Equality, ensuring all citizens are equal before the law.

questions.question: The Right to Information is guaranteed under which article?
questions.explanation: Article 27 of the Constitution guarantees the Right to Information, ensuring citizens can access information from public bodies.
